{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for non-numeric patterns
revenue_samples = sales_df['revenue'].sample(20, random_state=42)

# Check for currency symbols or other anomalies
revenue_samples_str = revenue_samples.astype(str)

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
conversion_errors = sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isnull().sum()

# Display the first few rows with the new column
top_rows_with_numeric = sales_df[['revenue', 'revenue_numeric']].head(10)

# Total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Confirm no negative values (which would be implausible)
has_negative = (sales_df['revenue_numeric'] < 0).any()

(revenue_samples_str, conversion_errors, top_rows_with_numeric, revenue_by_channel, has_negative)"}
